hero.h1: The same sun. The same stone. Thousands of years.
hero.h2: In the heart of Cappadocia, independent suite homes where time slows down.
hero.body:
Those who carved the stone to create life, who prayed, who thought, who kept silent…
From the Hittites to today, this light has never faded.

Anitya Cave House consists of three private suite homes,
with no shared spaces, dedicated entirely to guests,
located within these ancient stones.

identity.title: Not a hotel. No shared spaces. Yours alone.
identity.text:
Anitya Cave House is not a hotel.
It consists of three independent suite homes with no shared spaces,
located within the same structure.

• 2 cave suites
• 1 stone suite

Each suite has:
• Its own entrance
• Its own private terrace
• Its own fully equipped kitchen
• Its own living area and bedroom

One of the suite homes also has a separate salon area.

These are not lived-in spaces.
All are prepared exclusively for guests.

balloon.title: Can you see balloons from the terrace?
balloon.text:
Yes.
Weather permitting, it is possible to watch hot air balloons from our private terraces in the early morning hours.

Sunrise in Cappadocia is experienced with silence, stone, and balloons floating in the sky.

For many of our guests, this is the most unforgettable moment of the day.

terrace.title: Terrace view
terrace.text:
From our private terraces, you can see:
• Cappadocia's unique rock formations
• Valleys and pigeon houses
• Stone houses of Ortahisar town
• Mount Erciyes in the distance on clear days

The view offers both the natural and settled texture of Cappadocia together.

suiteExperience.title: Not a room, an independent home
suiteExperience.text:
Staying at Anitya means experiencing not just a room,
but an independent home that belongs to you.

• Silence
• Privacy
• Your own rhythm
• Your own kitchen
• Your own terrace

You share no space with anyone.
You set the pace of your day.

kitchen.title: Fully equipped kitchen in every suite
kitchen.text:
All our suite homes have fully equipped kitchens.

This is not just comfort;
it's freedom and independence.

• For long-stay guests
• For guests with children
• For those who want to maintain their own dietary routines

Anitya is for those who prefer home comfort over hotel breakfast schedules.

breakfast.title: Breakfast and dining options
breakfast.text:
Anitya Cave House does not have a fixed breakfast service.

Instead:
• Restaurants offering excellent breakfast within a 2-minute walk
• Many different options within a 4-5 minute walk, from traditional Turkish breakfast to world cuisine

Breakfast and meals can also be ordered from restaurants in Ortahisar center to the suite homes.

Our guests choose to have breakfast outside if they wish,
or at home, at their own pace.

location.title: Walking distance to Ortahisar center
location.text:
Anitya Cave House is approximately a 5-minute walk to the center of Ortahisar town.

Away from the crowds of Göreme,
yet right in the center of Cappadocia.

Ortahisar is one of the most authentic settlements in Cappadocia,
with its history, stone architecture, and tranquility.

finalCta.title: For those who want to live Cappadocia like home
finalCta.text:
Anitya Cave House is for those who choose not crowded hotels,
but silence, space, and independence.

about.title: About Anitya Cave House
about.content:
In the heart of Cappadocia, Ortahisar Village, which has been a homeland for Hittites, Persians, Romans, Byzantines, Seljuks, Ottoman Empire since 1800 BC's, Anitya houses are the caves which had remained from this rich history.

Experiencing to live in a cave which had kept all the histories and life energies in it and feeling the strength-softness-peace all together will be unforgettable. It has changed our life, we are learning a lot and we would like to share this special feeling with you.

We would be glad to welcome you in our house with an open heart and full of love…

caveSuite.title: Cave Suite
caveSuite.subtitle: CAVE SUITE WITH TERRACE
caveSuite.description: A cavehouse of 80 square meter, fully equipped with a scenic terrace is offered for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation. Fully built and decorated with handmade, antique and traditional furnitures.

specifications.beds: Queen bed in the bedroom, a double bed in the mini cave area for sitting/sleeping and a sofa at the saloon convertable into a double bed.
specifications.house: Master bedroom, large living room with TV, study corner, a minicave for sitting/sleeping, kitchen with dining table and one bathroom.
specifications.decoration: Fully built and decorated with handmade, antique and traditional furniture. The traditional Turkish carpets lay on the ground for your comfort.
specifications.location: Private original cave suite with huge windows and scenic terrace
specifications.bathrooms: 24 hour hot water with a bathtub
specifications.extraBed: One sofa, convertible into a double bed in the saloon. A double bed in the mini cave area for sitting/sleeping. Crib provided. One more extra bed can be provided to the saloon.
specifications.terrace: A private sitting area and dining table with the breathtaking scenery of Erciyes Mountain (in clear sky) and Ishak Castle with Cappadocia landscape and Ortahisar village houses.

kitchen: All kitchen equipment for cooking and eating
Herbal Teas, Filter Coffee, Turkish coffee, Black Tea, Oil for cooking, Dish Soap, Spices are all available for the use of our guests.
guestServices: Traditional Turkish Breakfast service is provided
Free wireless internet access in common areas; terraces
Main laundry room for guests' use, with iron and ironing board, laundry hanger
Free sightseeing maps of Cappadocia with guidance
Helping for all needs and arranging, reserving activities in the region.

caveSuite.specialNote: Anitya Cave House is a special private boutique hotel which doesn't have 7/24 reception and restaurant service. Staffs are ready to come in all other needs.

testimonials.text: Such a warm and well equipped cave! Our host could not be more helpful, the lighting and technology is superb and the view from the terrasse is breathtaking. The area is so beautiful and there is lots to see and do. Thank you for an excellent stay.
testimonials.author: Guest

testimonials.text: Unique space! I highly recommend staying here if you want to enjoy Cappadocia in the perfect way that it should be. There are many cave houses to stay in, but the hospitality that these hosts provided was outstanding to me. If I'm ever back in the park I know where I'm staying!
testimonials.author: Guest

testimonials.text: We loved our winter stay in Cappadochia and Anitya Cave House was the perfect home base for us. Our family of three loved staying in quiet Ortahisar, rather than one of the more touristy towns in the region. Every morning we were served a diverse and delicious Turkish breakfast with many kinds of cheese, walnuts, bread, the best honey I've ever had, dried apricots, fresh raisins, fresh apricot jam, two kinds of olives, halvah, hot tea, and more. Never in my life have I experienced such kindness, generosity and service! The folks at Anitya Cave House are just incredible.
testimonials.author: Guest
